'''2001 Origins Open''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG Open tournament at the Origins game convention in Columbus, Ohio, in early July 2001.<ref name="dt-17376">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17376 Kim's Agents Are Landing], DeckTech (Kimberly "Arwen Even*" Caton, 9 July 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17376/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17376/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' early July 2001 (before 7 July)
* '''Site:''' Origins, Columbus, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' —

The players' DeckTech posts of 7 and 9 July 2001 describe the event as just played; they give no exact day. It was played before [[Coruscant (expansion)|Coruscant]] was tournament legal. The posts do not name the winner.

== Results ==

Results below come from players' own DeckTech deck posts. Each row cites the post that gives it. A Dark or Light cell shows — until the deck page is linked.

Caton's Dark deck "went undefeated in the Origins Open"; she wrote that it "rolled over everything at Origins" and beat Scott L's Rebel Strike Team deck.<ref name="dt-17376" /> [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] posted a Dark [[Bastian Winkelhaus The SUPERSTAR is back with a vengeance|Set Your Course For Alderaan podracing deck]] two days earlier, describing it as "the deck that won Origins"; the post does not say who played it there.<ref name="dt-17342">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17342 The SUPERSTAR is back with a vengeance], DeckTech (Bastian "Death Star" Winkelhaus, 7 July 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17342/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17342/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
